facts.fact: The CEMAC regulation of 21 December 2018 on payment services replaced the 2011 e-money rules, which had covered e-money issuance only, and is the framework under which Chad's payment establishments are licensed (L'Economie, 29 July 2026).

Moov Money Tchad SA, a telecom subsidiary, holds a COBAC payment-establishment licence with FCFA 500 million minimum paid-up capital, confirmed in Maroc Telecom's half-year report of 22 July 2026, the third non-bank in Chad so licensed.
Airtel Money in Chad was licensed as a payment establishment by COBAC in 2023, and the fintech Konoom in 2025, per the article.

systems.owner: Moov Money Tchad SA (Maroc Telecom group)
